source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Marissa,

After reviewing the options, my feedback is as follows:

\* Concepts 5 and 8 are definitely stronger for me than 11 and 14.
\* The dark-mode landing page has a technical but sophisticated feel that I like, and the purple background on 5 and 8 looks excellent.
\* Emphasizing the first sentence of the hero text works especially well—better than emphasizing the tagline.
\* At least for the headline text, Alan Sans feels warmer and more approachable, which I like (now they've got me at it!).
\* To my surprise, green works well for the buttons.
\* I remain undecided between the single-color and two-color logo treatments.
\* I am not sure whether the screens are placeholders, though they may offer an interesting direction to explore.
\* Is the remaining initial copy intended for this landing page, or would it move to follow-on pages?
\* Are you planning to use a common page footer?

I look forward to seeing the next updates.

Derek

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Derek!

Ready for your review now is a mock-up of the complete landing page. A few implementation notes:

\- All headers use Alan Sans
\- Light imagery now appears throughout the site
\- At the bottom of the page, I added a contact form; please let me know whether you would like it retained or removed
\- Because the footer content has not yet been specified, I included a basic footer that I am happy to revise as needed

I look forward to your feedback!

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that a complete landing-page mock-up is ready, with Alan Sans used for all headers and light imagery used throughout.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marissa,

After working on your landing-page design, I deployed it to S3 behind CloudFront at <https://cdn.lumenarc-demo.example>. I’ve also added more copy and made a few minor adjustments, and I think it’s coming together well. Please let me know what you think, and I hope you had a good weekend.

The tenant dashboard sign-in is now implemented and working, although it still needs LumenArc branding. The sign-up wizard is halfway through development, and I’ll add it only after it is fully functional. May I send you an invitation for a LumenArc login so you can review both? Let me know which email address I should use, or whether you would prefer that I create a <http://lumenarc-demo.example|lumenarc-demo.example> email account for you.

Regarding navigation, I agree with your decision to leave it out of the header. Instead, I’ll gradually add links to the footer, which appears to be the current trend; I captured several footer examples to see how others are handling it.

Best,
Derek

execution.observed_behavior: Client reports implementing and deploying the landing-page design to S3 behind CloudFront after making minor adjustments.
